comparison.objective: Compress spring tongs and pull their locking tab, versus break and recover four HELICOIL tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Maintaining compression while translating a latch tab rather than maintaining coaxial mandrel alignment during a hammer strike.
comparison.success_condition: Tongs shut and pull tab extended; detailed positional thresholds are absent. Candidate requires irreversible fractures plus recovery of all released pieces.
comparison.reason: Shared bimanual stabilization is generic; latch actuation does not test impact fracture or free-fragment containment.
